scientific_integrity: The claim is mathematically proved by an explicit stationary probability generating function and almost-sure drift argument; finite exact checks are supplementary. Novelty comparisons are limited to accessible sources and indexing; independence and full historical priority are not established.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness is proved only among absolutely continuous probabilities whose densities are constant on each dyadic cell. The critical p=2/3 infinite invariant measure is prior work; no complete classification of non-shell-constant densities is asserted. Formula assumes independent map choices and branch boundaries with zero initial mass.
title: Off-critical endpoint escape and two density thresholds in the modified Boyarsky–Góra–Islam map
